Mods.Name: The Great War 1914-1918
Mods.Author: Meridian Front team
Mods.Description: Total conversion to the First World War: play the Ottoman Empire, Britain, Germany, France or Russia with their own infantry, cavalry, tanks, biplanes, Zeppelins and dreadnoughts; Money and Oil instead of Material and Energy; seven battlefields from Gallipoli to the Western Front.
